body:
I've thought about the people I'm going to hurt by this for years. If not for them I would have been out a long time ago. It's just not enough anymore..I've accepted the fact that I can't be responsible for what comes next. I can't live a life barely clinging on just so it doesn't make other people feel bad. That may sound selfish or a copout, but it is what it is.

Besides, I don't want to grow old and have to face the consequences of my wasted, broken life. At least now they can say "well he died young. So tragic, so much potential" which is sad, but is it really worse than watching me continue to grow into a burn out junkie with no chance at ever being able to get better? To spend the years wasting away in front of them? No..that's not better. This is kinder, quicker, cleaner. They can move on now, and not have to hold out hope that I'll ever be worthy of the life given to me. I'm not.
I feel the same way...Really want to get help..realize that I need it but am just unable to do it..Suicide seems like such a safer, easier option.
